name: Diffusion

name: Halo Fund
rationale: Led Savvy Wealth's $100M Series C (Sep 9, 2026) at a $600M valuation. Founded by Qualtrics founder/Utah Jazz owner Ryan Smith and longtime Accel GP Ryan Sweeney.

name: Doerr Capital
rationale: Co-led Mazama Energy's oversubscribed $135M Series B (Sep 17, 2026) with Centaurus Capital -- John Doerr's family office increasingly active as a lead in AI-adjacent power/energy deals.

name: Centaurus Capital
rationale: Co-led Mazama Energy's $135M Series B (Sep 17, 2026) with Doerr Capital; new lead name in the geothermal/power-energy space.

name: Energy Impact Partners
rationale: Led Voya Energy's $13M seed (Nov 2025) and $35M Series A (Aug 26, 2026); recurring co-investor alongside Founders Fund in power-energy/AI-adjacent infrastructure.

name: Mare Liberum
